_comment: Durable PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG for replaying the P-006 real-engine journeys. The previous copy lived at .papercusp/scratch/p006/account-catalog.json, which .gitignore:187 (**/.papercusp/scratch/) excludes — so any recorded replay command pointing there stops reproducing the moment that scratch directory is gone (the same trap as plan Decision D-012: a scratch-only artifact is not durable). This file is route metadata ONLY: agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts validates each entry against /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/ with provider in [claude, codex] and notes that 'the isolated operator needs only the catalogue for route validation. Credentials and all upstream selection remain in the real gateway.' No credentials are present or required here.
